name: a link whose text carries brackets
why: CommonMark says link text may hold balanced brackets, so a renderer reads this as a link to javascript:. The snapshot's reader stops at the first ']' and finds no target at all, so the destination reaches the page unchecked: a reader that cannot read a link whole must refuse the fact, not pass it.
fails: writes a link in a form this snapshot does not read

rows.headline: protection worked by surprise
rows.entry: Read [the writeup [part two]](javascript:alert(1)) for the detail.
